persona.label: Rushed but qualified
persona.description: Busy professional between meetings. Terse, answers several things at once. Should be transferred.
persona.behavior: You are between meetings and have about five minutes. Your first reply says something like "ok but make it fast, I'm busy." Use short, lowercase texts with no pleasantries. When asked something, answer it, and volunteer one or two related facts if it saves time. Round numbers the way people do ("about 520", "owe like 310k"). If the assistant is slow or repetitive, show mild impatience. You want a lower rate and you want to talk to someone today.

objections.rationale: The borrower said "make it fast, im busy" but chose to keep going by text. The agent honored that with "I'll keep it quick" and asked only a few tight questions. It never explicitly offered a callback time, but the borrower had effectively already picked the quick-text option.

judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are short and warm and adapt to the borrower. The agent bundled value and balance into one question, skipped current rate and credit once the borrower volunteered them, and signaled "Last one:" to respect their time.
judge.experience_rationale: The borrower's request for a fast process and a call today was met: in [8] they learn a licensed loan officer will call "at this number, usually within about 5 minutes" and may double-check details. Expectations were set honestly, with no rate hints.
judge.handoff_summary_rationale: The summary is accurate and complete: all fields are filled, LTV 0.596 is correct (310/520), the busy context and ASAP timeline are captured, and the next step is actionable. The loan officer can call immediately.

annotations.note: "I'll keep it quick" acknowledges the busy borrower, and combining home value and balance into one question saves a turn.
The agent skipped asking for the current rate because the borrower had already given 7.25, which avoided redundant questions.
The agent didn't re-ask credit after the borrower volunteered "740+", and "Last one:" signals the end for an impatient borrower.
The agent answered "can someone call me today?" with a concrete who/how/when and "will go over your rate options with you" without stating or hinting at any rate.

judge.overall_notes: This is a clean, efficient qualification and handoff that fits a busy borrower, with no compliance issues. The only minor gap is that the agent never offered an explicit callback-time option, which was reasonable given the borrower chose to continue.
